title: 2008 HMMT November Guts Problem 13
statement: Find the number of distinct primes dividing \(1 \cdot 2 \cdot 3 \cdots 9 \cdot 10\).

solutions.text: 4 A prime divides this product if and only if it divides one of the multiplicands, so prime divisors of this product must be less than 10 . There are 4 primes less than 10 , namely, \(2,3,5\), and 7 .
